subject: general
question: Which of the following is a statistical tool that measures a country’s overall achievement in terms of health, education and income?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Human development index**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Human development index**

 
 
• The** first UNDP Human Development Report was published in 1990.**
 
• The Human Development Index is a report published by the United Nations Development Program (UNDP).</
